findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: bounty_advertise · Private data: bounty_discover, bounty_solve, bounty_rounds, bounty_peers, bounty_advertise · Public sink: bounty_solve, bounty_combine, bounty_peers, bounty_consent, bounty_next_move · Destructive: bounty_register, bounty_delist, bounty_next_move.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: bounty_advertise · Private data: bounty_discover, bounty_solve, bounty_rounds, bounty_peers, bounty_advertise · Public sink: bounty_solve, bounty_combine, bounty_peers, bounty_consent, bounty_next_move · Destructive: bounty_register, bounty_delist, bounty_next_move

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
